caption: The drawing features a wooden cradle with a rectangular box-like body positioned horizontally and supported by two rocker legs on each side, forming an H-frame structure with connecting dowels for stability. The cradle is rendered in various earthy tones, primarily browns with visible wood grain, and has areas of faded blue and gray paint that are unevenly distributed across its surfaces, giving it a weathered appearance. Each end of the cradle is framed by vertical wooden posts rising above the height of the cradle box, with horizontal rods extending between the posts at the top and sides, and slightly curved ends. The front panel of the cradle has a decorative, irregular-shaped motif in a lighter color, while the edges and joints show different shades of paint and wood wear. The cradle is set against a plain, off-white background. In the lower right corner, the words "Grace Thomas Santa Fe" are written in cursive.
title: Baby Cradle
